<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="600" viewBox="0 0 400 600" role="img" aria-labelledby="tb-title tb-description">
  <title id="tb-title">Treble bleed plošný spoj</title>
  <desc id="tb-description">Pohľad zhora na čierny plošný spoj podľa referenčnej fotografie. Dva SMD rezistory, jeden kondenzátor, zlatá horná plocha s polkruhovým výrezom a dva spodné spájkovacie kontakty. Priehľadné pozadie. Body pripojenia na spodných kontaktoch: (122, 520), (278, 520).</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tb-substrate" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#d4cfaf"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#9b9c80"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c3c2a1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tb-mask" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#353638"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#252729"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#303233"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tb-gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.85" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#e1af45"/>
      <stop offset="0.2" stop-color="#ffe7a0"/>
      <stop offset="0.52" stop-color="#f6d579"/>
      <stop offset="0.8" stop-color="#ffe5a0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c99432"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tb-solder" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.2" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#888b87"/>
      <stop offset="0.25" stop-color="#f5f2df"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#babcb3"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#e2e0cf"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#747773"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tb-ceramic" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop stop-color="#9f9e91"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#d8d7cd"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b8b8ac"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <path id="tb-outline" d="M40 32 H146 A54 54 0 0 0 254 32 H360 Q366 32 366 38 V562 Q366 568 360 568 H307 A29 29 0 0 0 249 568 H151 A29 29 0 0 0 93 568 H40 Q34 568 34 562 V38 Q34 32 40 32 Z"/>
    <clipPath id="tb-clip"><use href="#tb-outline"/></clipPath>
    <g id="tb-smd-pads">
      <rect x="-25" y="-49" width="50" height="100" rx="5" fill="#111516" stroke="#e5eee9" stroke-width="6"/>
      <rect x="-16" y="-38" width="32" height="24" rx="2" fill="url(#tb-gold)" stroke="#825d20"/>
      <rect x="-16" y="15" width="32" height="24" rx="2" fill="url(#tb-gold)" stroke="#825d20"/>
    </g>
    <g id="tb-smd-resistor">
      <use href="#tb-smd-pads"/>
      <rect x="-14" y="-32" width="28" height="66" rx="2" fill="#111314" stroke="#55584e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <path d="M-14-30 H14 V-20 Q0-16-14-20 Z M-14 21 Q0 18 14 21 V33 H-14 Z" fill="url(#tb-solder)" stroke="#8c8c7c" stroke-width="0.7"/>
      <path d="M-11-27 Q0-31 11-27 M-11 28 Q0 24 11 28" fill="none" stroke="#fff9df" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- All cutouts are transparent, including those in the gold contacts. -->
  <use href="#tb-outline" fill="url(#tb-substrate)" stroke="#b5b69d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#tb-clip)">
    <rect x="40" y="37" width="320" height="522" rx="3" fill="url(#tb-mask)"/>
    <path d="M41 37 H359 V109 H41 Z" fill="url(#tb-gold)" stroke="#bd923a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M43 39 H357 M43 106 H357" fill="none" stroke="#fff0bd" stroke-opacity="0.6" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Subtle traces under the dark solder mask. -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#16191a" stroke-width="15" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <path d="M122 230 H278"/>
      <path d="M122 286 V518"/>
      <path d="M200 286 V368 H278 V518"/>
      <path d="M278 286 V518"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#454137" stroke-opacity="0.65" stroke-width="12" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <path d="M122 230 H278"/>
      <path d="M122 286 V518"/>
      <path d="M200 286 V368 H278 V518"/>
      <path d="M278 286 V518"/>
    </g>

    <!-- White silkscreen and component outlines. -->
    <g fill="#e5efec" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="200" y="158" font-size="19" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1.6">TREBLE BLEED</text>
      <path d="M145 172 H255" fill="none" stroke="#e5efec" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
      <text transform="translate(108 342) rotate(90)" font-size="24" font-weight="700">R2</text>
      <text transform="translate(186 342) rotate(90)" font-size="24" font-weight="700">R1</text>
      <text transform="translate(264 342) rotate(90)" font-size="24" font-weight="700">C1</text>
      <text x="200" y="436" font-size="29" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">MY-TB01</text>
      <text x="160" y="478" font-size="24" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2">REV A</text>
    </g>

    <use href="#tb-smd-resistor" transform="translate(122 258)"/>
    <use href="#tb-smd-resistor" transform="translate(200 258)"/>
    <g fill="#e4e1c9" font-family="monospace" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">
      <text transform="translate(118 258) rotate(90)">2002</text>
      <text transform="translate(196 258) rotate(90)">1503</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(278 258)">
      <use href="#tb-smd-pads"/>
      <rect x="-14" y="-32" width="28" height="66" rx="2" fill="url(#tb-ceramic)" stroke="#7b7d75"/>
      <path d="M-14-31 H14 V-19 Q0-16-14-19 Z M-14 20 Q0 17 14 20 V33 H-14 Z" fill="url(#tb-solder)" stroke="#8c8c7c" stroke-width="0.7"/>
      <path d="M-11-27 Q0-31 11-27 M-11 28 Q0 24 11 28" fill="none" stroke="#fff9df" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Two castellated solder contacts along the bottom edge. -->
    <g stroke="#161a18" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <path id="terminal-1" d="M77 500 H167 V568 H77 Z" fill="url(#tb-gold)"/>
      <path id="terminal-2" d="M233 500 H323 V568 H233 Z" fill="url(#tb-gold)"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#a57420" stroke-width="3">
      <path d="M92 568 A30 30 0 0 1 152 568"/>
      <path d="M248 568 A30 30 0 0 1 308 568"/>
    </g>
    <path d="M80 503 H164 M236 503 H320" fill="none" stroke="#fff0bc" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M40 558 H88 M156 558 H244 M312 558 H360" stroke="#b8b995" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
  <use href="#tb-outline" fill="none" stroke="#a7a88e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>
name: Treble bleed circuit
description: A treble bleed creates a "bypass lane" that lets high frequencies skip around the volume control as you turn it down. Your overall volume drops, but your clarity and sparkle remain intact. It has zero effect on your tone when the volume knob is turned all the way up.
